summary: LATAM Airlines Group filed a Form 6-K with its 1Q 2026 earnings results. It reports revenues of $4,151M (+21.7% YoY), adjusted EBITDA of $1,315M, and net income of $576M. The filing discloses routine operational and financial metrics, capacity growth, and liquidity of $4,116M. There is no merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, spin-off, or other special situation. The 6-K is a standard periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a U.S. earnings release. No special-situation event is present.
